entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options
entities.description: Information element included when UE wishes to transmit protocol data to the network. Used for configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that initiates transmission of protocol data to the network.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that receives protocol data from the UE.

entities.name: Extended PCO supported end-to-end
entities.description: Condition that extended protocol configuration options is supported by both UE and network end-to-end for the PDN connection.

entities.name: PDN connection
entities.description: Packet Data Network connection for which extended protocol configuration options support is required.

relations.description: Inclusion of extended protocol configuration options IE is conditional upon end-to-end support by both UE and network
Extended PCO support condition applies specifically to the PDN connection
UE triggers inclusion of extended protocol configuration options when wishing to transmit protocol data
